//go:build !(go1.27 && !http2legacy)

// Copied into the upstream internal test package by test_upstream.py.
package http2

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"sync"
	"testing"
)

type relayChunkBudget struct {
	mu          sync.Mutex
	limit, used int64
}

func (b *relayChunkBudget) TryAcquire(n int64) bool {
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	if n > b.limit-b.used {
		return false
	}
	b.used += n
	return true
}

func (b *relayChunkBudget) Release(n int64) {
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	b.used -= n
	if b.used < 0 {
		panic("receive buffer capacity released twice")
	}
}

func (b *relayChunkBudget) bytes() int64 {
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	return b.used
}

func TestRelayReceiveBudgetChargesChunkCapacity(t *testing.T) {
	for _, size := range []int{1, 1024, 1025, 2048, 2049, 4096, 4097, 8192, 8193, 16384} {
		budget := &relayChunkBudget{limit: 16384}
		b := &dataBuffer{budget: budget}
		payload := bytes.Repeat([]byte{'x'}, size)
		if n, err := b.Write(payload); n != size || err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("write %d bytes = %d, %v", size, n, err)
		}
		want := dataBufferChunkSize(int64(size))
		if got := budget.bytes(); got != want {
			t.Fatalf("%d-byte payload charged %d bytes, want chunk capacity %d", size, got, want)
		}
		got := make([]byte, size)
		if n, err := b.Read(got); n != size || err != nil || !bytes.Equal(got, payload) {
			t.Fatalf("read %d-byte payload = %d, %v", size, n, err)
		}
		if got := budget.bytes(); got != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("consumed final partial chunk retains %d bytes", got)
		}
		b.discard()
	}
}

func TestRelayReceiveBudgetPartialWriteAndDiscard(t *testing.T) {
	budget := &relayChunkBudget{limit: 16 << 10}
	b := &dataBuffer{budget: budget}
	if n, err := b.Write(make([]byte, 20<<10)); n != 16<<10 || !errors.Is(err, errReceiveBufferBudget) {
		t.Fatalf("partial allocation failure = %d, %v; want 16384 and budget error", n, err)
	}
	if b.Len() != 16<<10 || budget.bytes() != 16<<10 {
		t.Fatal("partial write lost buffered bytes or its capacity charge")
	}
	b.discard()
	b.discard()
	if budget.bytes() != 0 {
		t.Fatal("discard retained capacity")
	}
	if n, err := b.Write([]byte{'y'}); n != 1 || err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("released capacity was unavailable: %d, %v", n, err)
	}
	b.discard()
}

func TestRelayReceiveBudgetPipeLifetime(t *testing.T) {
	for _, breakPipe := range []bool{false, true} {
		budget := &relayChunkBudget{limit: 1024}
		p := &pipe{b: &dataBuffer{budget: budget}}
		if _, err := p.Write([]byte("hello")); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if breakPipe {
			p.BreakWithError(errClosedBody)
			p.BreakWithError(errClosedBody)
			if p.Len() != 5 || budget.bytes() != 0 {
				t.Fatal("break must retain unread flow bytes while releasing capacity")
			}
		} else {
			p.CloseWithError(io.EOF)
			if budget.bytes() != 1024 {
				t.Fatal("EOF released bytes that the handler still owns")
			}
			got, err := io.ReadAll(p)
			if string(got) != "hello" || err != nil || budget.bytes() != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("EOF drain = %q, %v, capacity %d", got, err, budget.bytes())
			}
		}
	}
}

func TestRelayHandlerPanicResetCompletionAfterPeerClose(t *testing.T) {
	for _, peerClosed := range []bool{false, true} {
		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
		defer cancel()
		sc := &serverConn{
			hs: &http.Server{}, srv: &Server{}, serveG: newGoroutineLock(),
			streams: make(map[uint32]*stream), curClientStreams: 1,
			writeSched: NewRoundRobinWriteScheduler(),
		}
		st := &stream{id: 1, sc: sc, state: stateOpen, ctx: ctx, cancelCtx: cancel, cw: make(closeWaiter)}
		sc.streams[1] = st
		sc.writeSched.OpenStream(1, OpenStreamOptions{})
		// A panic reset has entered an asynchronous network write. Peer RST
		// can close the stream before that write's completion arrives.
		sc.writingFrame, sc.writingFrameAsync = true, true
		if peerClosed {
			sc.closeStream(st, streamError(1, ErrCodeCancel))
		}
		sc.wroteFrame(frameWriteResult{wr: FrameWriteRequest{write: handlerPanicRST{1}, stream: st}})
		if st.state != stateClosed || len(sc.streams) != 0 || sc.curClientStreams != 0 {
			t.Fatal("panic reset completion did not release exactly one stream")
		}
	}
}
